rules.name: Crazy deal
rules.note: An offer more than 15c below the model's own fair value is someone else's information, not our edge. Live: 15c+ went 4 losses in 9 fills; 5-15c went 24-0 for +$32.20, which is why the line is 15 and not 5. The confidence condition was dropped after KXSOL15M 2026-09-11 slipped through at 99.508%. The 15c line is FITTED on 9 fills and claims no significance; the 40-record review decides it.
